data.long_meaning: Deepa (light) + Shree (prosperity, wealth) = Deepashree. A name symbolizing the attainment of spiritual and material wealth through knowledge. The name Deepashree carries the meaning “Light of Knowledge” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Deepashree usually hope their child will grow to embody light of knowledge and live with faith, good character and purpose.

historical_references.reference: In Hindu mythology, Deepashree was the name of the daughter of King Vibhishana when he married Mandodari, sister of Ravana. She was a devoted wife and an ideal woman. She is often depicted as the embodiment of purity and devotion.

Another reference to Deepashree can be found in the Puranic literature where she is mentioned as the daughter of sage Vibhishana and Tara, sister of Valmiki. She is considered the goddess of inner light and knowledge.

It is frequently featured on social media platforms where parents share their naming journeys, and Hindu name websites where expectant parents research meaningful names. The name bridges traditional Hindu values with modern Indian identity, making it relevant for contemporary families seeking names with deep spiritual and cultural significance.
